goal:
T43 — Feedback Intelligence: turn feedback on a mission into a linked improvement mission (closed loop).

1. NEW services/api/evoforge/feedback.py + routes in services/api/main.py:
   - POST /v1/feedback {mission_id, kind: "bug"|"missed_case"|"praise"|"other" (Literal, else 422), text (1..2000 chars)}
     -> 201 {feedback_id, ...}. Unknown mission_id -> 404 (link integrity).
   - Before storing, scrub personal data and secrets from text: email addresses -> "[email]", tokens such as
     ghp_/gho_/github_pat_/sk-/sk-live_/AKIA... and long hex/base64 secrets (>= 24 chars) -> "[secret]".
   - Store each item in the existing evidence store (postgres_state.ScopedRecords("records"), kind "feedback") so it
     survives redeploys; GET /v1/feedback -> {feedback: [...]} newest first (<= 100), each with feedback_id, mission_id,
     kind, text (scrubbed), created_at, promoted_mission_id (null until promoted).
   - POST /v1/feedback/{id}/promote -> creates a new mission through the existing missions store with goal =
     "<original mission goal>

Follow-up from feedback (<kind>): <scrubbed text>", same repo_ref/target_paths,
     records promoted_mission_id on the feedback and the feedback_id on the new mission's evidence; returns 201
     {mission_id, feedback_id}. Promoting again returns the same mission (200 or 409 naming it), never a second one.
2. Web: apps/web/lib/api.ts postFeedback(), listFeedback(), promoteFeedback(); a feedback form (kind select + text) on
   the Mission Control mission detail and a feedback list with a "개선 미션으로 승격" button (apps/web/components/
   FeedbackPanel.tsx used from apps/web/app/[locale]/page.tsx); strings in both messages files.
3. apps/web/lib/proxyPolicy.ts + cases: allow POST /v1/feedback, GET /v1/feedback, POST /v1/feedback/<id>/promote.
Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t43.py. Do not change sealed_eval.py or patch.py.
